Este notebook replica en **Larch 6** la especificacion principal del notebook [05_nested_logit_od_buffers.qmd](/Users/vicenteonetto/Desktop/FCFM/MDS/Tesis_Local/tesis-project/03_models/05_nested_logit_od_buffers.qmd):

- observacion = viaje individual (`Option1`);
- atributos construidos a nivel `OD x tipo_pago`;
- filtro a `OD` con `BIP`, `QR_RED` y `QR_OTHER` observados;
- `leave_one_out` solo para la alternativa elegida;
- utilidades completas para `BIP`, `QR_RED` y `QR_OTHER`;
- comparacion entre:
  - **MNL** con esta misma utilidad como benchmark principal;
  - **Nested Logit** con nido `QR = {QR_RED, QR_OTHER}` como contraste.

::: {.callout-note}
En **Larch**, el parametro del nido se define en la forma usual de **logsum parameter** (`lambda`) con rango `(0, 1]`.  
En **Biogeme**, el parametro equivalente se reporta como `MU >= 1`.  
Para comparar ambos:

`MU_biogeme ~= 1 / Mu:QR_larch`
:::

## 1) Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup

import gc
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
from scipy.stats import norm

import larch as lx
from larch import P, X


def resolve_project_root(start: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    current = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()
    for candidate in [current, *current.parents]:
        if (candidate / "config").exists() and (candidate / "lib").exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("No se pudo resolver PROJECT_ROOT desde el notebook actual.")


PROJECT_ROOT = resolve_project_root()
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from lib.od_buffers_nested_logit import (
    OdContextConfig,
    build_od_alt_specific_context_table,
    build_trip_dataset_with_alt_specific_context,
    load_caracterizacion,
    read_parquet_portable,
    resolve_caracterizacion_path,
)

SEED = 42


def format_sample_tag(sample_fraction: float | None) -> str:
    if sample_fraction is None:
        return "full"
    pct = int(round(sample_fraction * 100))
    return f"sample{pct}pct"


def maybe_sample_df(df: pl.DataFrame, sample_fraction: float | None) -> pl.DataFrame:
    if sample_fraction is None:
        return df
    return df.sample(fraction=sample_fraction, shuffle=True, seed=SEED)


def prepare_larch_dataframe(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    remap = {0: 1, 1: 2, 2: 3}
    out = (
        df.with_columns(
            pl.col("choice_nested")
            .replace(remap)
            .cast(pl.Int16)
            .alias("choice_larch")
        )
        .drop("choice_nested")
    )
    pdf = out.to_pandas()
    for col in pdf.columns:
        if col == "choice_larch":
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("int32")
        elif pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(pdf[col]):
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("int32")
        elif pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(pdf[col]):
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("float64")
    return pdf


def build_larch_stats_frame(model: lx.Model, n_obs: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    stats_raw = model.estimation_statistics_raw(compute_loglike_null=True)
    stats = {
        "Number of estimated parameters": len(model.pf),
        "Number of free parameters": int((model.pf["holdfast"] == 0).sum()),
        "Sample size": int(n_obs),
    }
    for key, value in stats_raw.items():
        if isinstance(key, tuple):
            label = " | ".join(str(k) for k in key)
        else:
            label = str(key)
        stats[label] = value
    return pd.DataFrame([stats])


def build_larch_params_frame(model: lx.Model) -> pd.DataFrame:
    pf = model.pf.copy().reset_index().rename(columns={"param_name": "Param", "value": "Value"})
    robust_std_err = np.asarray(model.parameters["robust_std_err"].values, dtype=float)
    robust_t = np.where(
        np.isfinite(robust_std_err) & (robust_std_err > 0),
        pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float) / robust_std_err,
        np.nan,
    )
    robust_p = np.where(np.isfinite(robust_t), 2 * norm.sf(np.abs(robust_t)), np.nan)
    lower = pf["minimum"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    upper = pf["maximum"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    value = pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    active_lower = np.isfinite(lower) & (np.abs(value - lower) <= 1e-6)
    active_upper = np.isfinite(upper) & (np.abs(value - upper) <= 1e-6)
    pf["Robust std err."] = robust_std_err
    pf["Robust t-stat."] = robust_t
    pf["Robust p-value"] = robust_p
    pf["Active bound"] = active_lower | active_upper
    pf["Biogeme-comparable MU"] = np.where(
        pf["Param"] == "Mu:QR",
        np.where(value != 0, 1.0 / value, np.nan),
        np.nan,
    )
    return pf[
        [
            "Param",
            "Value",
            "Robust std err.",
            "Robust t-stat.",
            "Robust p-value",
            "minimum",
            "maximum",
            "Active bound",
            "Biogeme-comparable MU",
        ]
    ].rename(columns={"minimum": "Lower bound", "maximum": "Upper bound"})


def build_larch_alt_specific_model(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    max_cap: float = 20.0,
    nested: bool = True,
) -> lx.Model:
    alts = {1: "BIP", 2: "QR_RED", 3: "QR_OTHER"}
    ds = lx.Dataset.construct.from_idco(pandas_df, alts=alts)
    m = lx.Model(ds)
    model_kind = "Nested" if nested else "MNL"
    m.title = f"{model_kind} OD Buffers alt-specific ({partition})"
    m.compute_engine = "numba"
    m.choice_co_code = "choice_larch"
    m.availability_co_vars = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1}

    m.utility_co[1] = (
        P.B_BIP_T_VEH * X.TVH_BIP
        + P.B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI * X.TEI_BIP
        + P.B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB * X.TET_BIP
        + P.B_BIP_N_TRASB * X.NTR_BIP
    )

    m.utility_co[2] = (
        P.ASC_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_LAB_PM * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + P.B_QR_RED_LAB_PT * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + P.B_QR_RED_NO_LAB * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + P.B_QR_RED_T_VEH * X.TVH_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI * X.TEI_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB * X.TET_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_N_TRASB * X.NTR_QR_RED
    )

    m.utility_co[3] = (
        P.ASC_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH * X.TVH_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI * X.TEI_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB * X.TET_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB * X.NTR_QR_OTHER
    )

    if nested:
        m.graph.new_node(parameter="Mu:QR", children=[2, 3], name="QR")
        m.ordering = [
            ("ASCs", "ASC_.*"),
            ("Time Dummies", "B_QR_.*_(LAB_PM|LAB_PT|NO_LAB)"),
            ("LOS", "B_.*_(T_VEH|T_ESPERA_INI|T_ESPERA_TRASB|N_TRASB)"),
            ("LogSums", "Mu:.*"),
        ]
    else:
        m.initialize_graph(alternative_codes=[1, 2, 3], alternative_names=["BIP", "QR_RED", "QR_OTHER"])
        m.ordering = [
            ("ASCs", "ASC_.*"),
            ("Time Dummies", "B_QR_.*_(LAB_PM|LAB_PT|NO_LAB)"),
            ("LOS", "B_.*_(T_VEH|T_ESPERA_INI|T_ESPERA_TRASB|N_TRASB)"),
        ]

    # Larch recomienda acotar parametros globalmente para evitar problemas numericos.
    m.set_cap(max_cap)
    return m


def estimate_larch_nested_option1_alt_specific(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    max_cap: float = 20.0,
    method: str = "slsqp",
    quiet: bool = False,
) -> tuple[lx.Model, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    m = build_larch_alt_specific_model(
        pandas_df,
        partition=partition,
        max_cap=max_cap,
        nested=True,
    )
    m.maximize_loglike(method=method, quiet=quiet)
    m.calculate_parameter_covariance(robust=True)

    stats = build_larch_stats_frame(m, n_obs=len(pandas_df))
    params = build_larch_params_frame(m)
    return m, stats, params


def estimate_larch_mnl_option1_alt_specific(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    max_cap: float = 20.0,
    method: str = "slsqp",
    quiet: bool = False,
) -> tuple[lx.Model, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    m = build_larch_alt_specific_model(
        pandas_df,
        partition=partition,
        max_cap=max_cap,
        nested=False,
    )
    m.maximize_loglike(method=method, quiet=quiet)
    m.calculate_parameter_covariance(robust=True)

    stats = build_larch_stats_frame(m, n_obs=len(pandas_df))
    params = build_larch_params_frame(m)
    return m, stats, params


print("✅ Setup listo")
print("Larch version:", lx.__version__)
```

## 3) Construcción / carga del contexto OD

```{python}
#| label: build-od-context

print("label: build-od-context")

lf = read_parquet_portable(str(PARQUET_PATH))

df_caract = None
if CARACTERIZACION_PATH:
    df_caract = load_caracterizacion(CARACTERIZACION_PATH)
    print(f"✅ Caracterización cargada: {df_caract.height:,} usuarios")

cfg = OdContextConfig(
    include_time_dummies=False,
    time_dummy_variant=TIME_DUMMY_VARIANT,
    mean_mode=OD_MEAN_MODE,
    require_all_alternatives=REQUIRE_ALL_THREE_ALTS,
)

df_od_context = build_od_alt_specific_context_table(
    lf,
    df_caract,
    config=cfg,
)

path_od_context = OD_ARTIFACTS_DIR / f"od_context_{PARTITION}.parquet"
df_od_context.write_parquet(path_od_context)

print("✅ OD context guardado en:", path_od_context)
display(df_od_context.head(5))
```

## 4) Construcción / carga del dataset final para Larch

```{python}
#| label: build-option1-dataset-v2

df_trips_v2 = build_trip_dataset_with_alt_specific_context(

    df_caract,
```

## 5) Smoke test de especificación en Larch

```{python}
#| label: smoke-test-larch

print("label: smoke-test-larch")

smoke_n = min(50_000, df_trips_v2.height)
df_smoke = df_trips_v2.head(smoke_n)
pdf_smoke = prepare_larch_dataframe(df_smoke)

print("Smoke rows:", len(pdf_smoke))
print("Choice codes:", sorted(pdf_smoke["choice_larch"].unique().tolist()))
print("Columns:", pdf_smoke.columns.tolist())

model_smoke, stats_smoke, params_smoke = estimate_larch_nested_option1_alt_specific(
    pdf_smoke,
    partition=f"{PARTITION}-SMOKE",
    method=LARCH_METHOD,
    max_cap=LARCH_MAX_CAP,
)

model_smoke_mnl, stats_smoke_mnl, params_smoke_mnl = estimate_larch_mnl_option1_alt_specific(
    pdf_smoke,
    partition=f"{PARTITION}-SMOKE-MNL",
    method=LARCH_METHOD,
    max_cap=LARCH_MAX_CAP,
)

print("✅ Smoke estimation nested en Larch corrió sin error.")
display(stats_smoke)
display(params_smoke.head(12))
print("✅ Smoke estimation MNL en Larch corrió sin error.")
display(stats_smoke_mnl)
display(params_smoke_mnl.head(12))
```

## 9) Comparación Larch: MNL vs nested

```{python}
#| label: compare-larch-mnl-vs-nested

print("label: compare-larch-mnl-vs-nested")

if (
    stats_path_mnl.exists()
    and params_path_mnl.exists()
    and stats_path_nested.exists()
    and params_path_nested.exists()
):
    larch_stats_mnl = pd.read_csv(stats_path_mnl)
    larch_params_nested = pd.read_csv(params_path_nested)
    larch_stats_nested = pd.read_csv(stats_path_nested)

    nested_mu = larch_params_nested.loc[larch_params_nested["Param"] == "Mu:QR", "Value"]
    nested_mu_biogeme = larch_params_nested.loc[
        larch_params_nested["Param"] == "Mu:QR", "Biogeme-comparable MU"
    ]

    comparison_larch = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "Model": "Larch MNL",
                "Sample size": larch_stats_mnl.iloc[0]["Sample size"],
                "Final log likelihood": larch_stats_mnl.iloc[0]["Log Likelihood at Convergence | Aggregate"],
                "Rho-square": larch_stats_mnl.iloc[0]["Rho Squared w.r.t. Null Parameters | Aggregate"],
                "Nested parameter (native)": np.nan,
                "Nested parameter (Biogeme scale)": np.nan,
                "Estimated parameters": larch_stats_mnl.iloc[0]["Number of estimated parameters"],
            },
            {
                "Model": "Larch nested",
                "Sample size": larch_stats_nested.iloc[0]["Sample size"],
                "Final log likelihood": larch_stats_nested.iloc[0]["Log Likelihood at Convergence | Aggregate"],
                "Rho-square": larch_stats_nested.iloc[0]["Rho Squared w.r.t. Null Parameters | Aggregate"],
                "Nested parameter (native)": nested_mu.iloc[0] if not nested_mu.empty else np.nan,
                "Nested parameter (Biogeme scale)": (
                    nested_mu_biogeme.iloc[0] if not nested_mu_biogeme.empty else np.nan
                ),
                "Estimated parameters": larch_stats_nested.iloc[0]["Number of estimated parameters"],
            },
        ]
    )
    display(comparison_larch)
else:
    print("⚠️ Faltan resultados de MNL o nested para comparar.")
```

## 10) Comparación básica contra Biogeme

```{python}
#| label: compare-vs-biogeme

print("label: compare-vs-biogeme")

biogeme_dir = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "03_models"
    / "biogeme-logit"
    / "results"
    / "05_od_buffers"
    / f"{PARTITION}-option1-v2-{format_sample_tag(SAMPLE_FRACTION)}"
)
biogeme_stats_path = biogeme_dir / f"stats_nested_logit_od_context_{PARTITION}.csv"
biogeme_params_path = biogeme_dir / f"params_nested_logit_od_context_{PARTITION}.csv"

if (
    biogeme_stats_path.exists()
    and biogeme_params_path.exists()
    and stats_path_nested.exists()
    and params_path_nested.exists()
):
    biogeme_stats = pd.read_csv(biogeme_stats_path)
    biogeme_params = pd.read_csv(biogeme_params_path)
    larch_stats = pd.read_csv(stats_path_nested)
    larch_params = pd.read_csv(params_path_nested)

    biogeme_mu = biogeme_params.loc[biogeme_params["Name"] == f"MU_QR_{PARTITION}", "Value"]
    larch_mu = larch_params.loc[larch_params["Param"] == "Mu:QR", "Value"]
    larch_mu_to_biogeme = larch_params.loc[
        larch_params["Param"] == "Mu:QR", "Biogeme-comparable MU"
    ]

    comparison = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "Framework": "Biogeme",
                "Sample size": biogeme_stats.iloc[0]["Sample size"],
                "Final log likelihood": biogeme_stats.iloc[0]["Final log likelihood"],
                "Rho-square": biogeme_stats.iloc[0]["Rho-square for the init. model"],
                "Nested parameter (native)": biogeme_mu.iloc[0] if not biogeme_mu.empty else np.nan,
                "Nested parameter (Biogeme scale)": biogeme_mu.iloc[0] if not biogeme_mu.empty else np.nan,
            },
            {
                "Framework": "Larch",
                "Sample size": larch_stats.iloc[0]["Sample size"],
                "Final log likelihood": larch_stats.iloc[0]["Log Likelihood at Convergence | Aggregate"],
                "Rho-square": larch_stats.iloc[0]["Rho Squared w.r.t. Null Parameters | Aggregate"],
                "Nested parameter (native)": larch_mu.iloc[0] if not larch_mu.empty else np.nan,
                "Nested parameter (Biogeme scale)": (
                    larch_mu_to_biogeme.iloc[0] if not larch_mu_to_biogeme.empty else np.nan
                ),
            },
        ]
    )
    display(comparison)
else:
    print("⚠️ Faltan resultados nested de Larch o Biogeme para comparar.")
```
